front: Where do you configure MCP servers for cloud agent at repo level?
back: Repo Settings > Copilot > MCP servers, as JSON with a top-level mcpServers object.

front: Required MCP config keys for cloud agent?
back: type (local, stdio, http, sse) and tools (list of tool names or ["*"]).

front: Local MCP server keys?
back: command, args, optional env.

front: Remote MCP server keys?
back: url and optional headers.

front: Secret/variable naming for MCP config?
back: Agents secrets/variables whose names start with COPILOT_MCP_; referenced as $VAR, ${VAR} or ${VAR:-default}.

front: Why allowlist specific read-only tools?
back: Copilot uses configured MCP tools autonomously and does not ask for approval first.

front: MCP limits for cloud agent and code review?
back: Tools only (no resources/prompts) and no remote servers requiring OAuth.

front: Which MCP servers are on by default for cloud agent?
back: GitHub MCP server and Playwright MCP server.

front: Default GitHub MCP token scope?
back: Read-only, current repository only. Use a fine-grained PAT or GitHub App for wider access.

front: Remote GitHub MCP URLs?
back: https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ and the read-only https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/readonly

front: How do you select toolsets on the remote GitHub MCP server?
back: X-MCP-Toolsets header (for example repos,issues,pull_requests); pick individual tools with the tools field.

front: How do you validate MCP config?
back: Assign an issue to Copilot, View session, open the 'Start MCP Servers' step in the log and check the listed tools.

front: Code review MCP tool requirement?
back: Each tool must set annotations.readOnlyHint to true or it is excluded.

front: Where is the environment setup workflow and what must the job be called?
back: .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml, job name copilot-setup-steps.

front: MCP server needs uv or pipx that is not on the runner. Fix?
back: Install it in copilot-setup-steps.yml.

front: Agent blocked by firewall on one host. Fix?
back: Add that host to the custom allowlist; do not disable the firewall.

front: Which branch can cloud agent push to?
back: One branch: a new copilot/ branch, or the PR branch when @copilot is mentioned on an existing PR. Branch protections still apply.

front: What can't cloud agent do to its own PR?
back: Mark Ready for review, approve, or merge. It also cannot run arbitrary git commands.

front: Do workflows run on agent PRs automatically?
back: No (default). A user with write access must click Approve and run workflows.

front: Retry policy for transient vs deterministic errors?
back: Transient: bounded retries with backoff, then escalate. Deterministic (denied, invalid config): do not retry; fix or escalate.

front: How do you roll back a bad agent change before merge?
back: Close the draft PR or revert commits on the copilot/ branch; the default branch is unaffected.

front: Traceability features of agent commits?
back: Authored by Copilot, requester as co-author, signed (Verified), message links to session log; admins get audit log events.

front: How can admins restrict which MCP servers are usable?
back: Org/enterprise MCP allowlist and registry policies (optionally restricting to registry servers). Verify names in docs.
